description.value: The Courtenay Branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library is a civic landmark in the heart of downtown Courtenay, recognized for its striking wood beam architecture that locals liken to the historic Creamery building that once stood in the area. Situated on the unceded traditional territories of the K'ómoks First Nation, it is described on its own website as a popular attraction for both residents and visitors. The branch offers meeting room bookings, technology help, and a broad range of library services through the Vancouver Island Regional Library system.
